description: Adversarial end-to-end corpus for the WeatherQuest action judge (reviewer task C). Every attack is submitted to complete_level on StudioNet at least twice from fresh throwaway accounts, and every legitimate action is submitted once from a fresh account. The measured layer (pre-filter revert versus LLM rubric rejection) comes from the chain, never from this file; layer_expected is only the hypothesis that the runner prints next to the measurement.
rules: No attack may ever produce a payout: credit delta 0, native balance delta 0, level not completed.
A rejected attack must leave the same account able to complete the level with a legitimate action and receive exactly base(level) * multiplier / 100.
All legitimate actions must be accepted; any false reject is reported, not hidden.

attack_target.note: Level 1 keeps the base reward at 0.10 GEN so a rejected attack costs nothing and a paid attack would be obvious. The reckless class is additionally run at the stormiest campaign city found by a live get_weather_multiplier scan.
